messages:
marta: Heads-up — we're seeing repeated evictions in eu-west1-gpu pool after the compactor ran at 03:10 UTC. Pods with local-affinity keep bouncing.
jiro: Yep noticed. Pods get scheduled to node A, then compactor moves others and node A gets tainted (gpu-burst: true) briefly, tolerations don't match, kubelet evicts. Logs show 'preemption due to node pressure' but nodes aren't full.
ops-bot: Compacting job started at 03:09:58 by descheduler/v1.3 (reason: consolidate-fragmented-gpus). Affected nodes: gpu-eu-1-12, gpu-eu-1-14, gpu-eu-1-19.
sam: Can you paste the descheduler policy? Suspect the threshold for consolidation is too aggressive.
marta: config snippet:
```
policy:
  nodeAffinityType: Prefer
  consolidateThresholds:
    cpu: 0.2
    gpu: 0.15
  drainGracePeriod: 10s
```
ana: 10s grace on drain is way too low for long init containers and KV cache warmups. Set to 3m and increase `maxEvictPerNode` to 2.
ana (fixing name to ana): sorry typo — I meant ana.
ana: (ignore previous)
ana: 10s grace on drain is way too low for long init containers and KV cache warmups. Set to 3m and increase `maxEvictPerNode` to 2.
jiro: Also we have mixed taints: 'gpu-burst' applied for short maintenance windows. Some of our serving pods don't tolerate it. Consider using tolerationSeconds or convert to a soft taint.
devon: Network note — when compaction moves pods between nodes in same AZ, SR-IOV attachments sometimes fail and kubelet retries then evicts; seen in kubelet logs: `eni: attach timeout` at ~03:12.
sam: Proposed immediate actions:
- pause compactor job for eu-west1 for 1h
- bump drainGracePeriod to 180s
- add tolerationSeconds for gpu-burst
- add pre-drain check for SR-IOV attachments
marta: I paused the job -> `kubectl -n infra patch cronjob/compactor --patch '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}'` :thumbsup: 
ana: I'll push config PR for thresholds + tolerationSeconds, then run canary in staging.
jiro: Filed ticket INFRA-1423 with logs and pcap. Let's also add metric 'eviction-restarts-per-node' to prometheus and alert on >3 in 15m.
ops-bot: Alert cleared for now (compactor suspended). Runbook updated: 'if eviction oscillation >3 in 15m, suspend compactor'.
marta: thanks all — syncing with oncall at 09:30.
